title: 10-Minute Kanda Poha with Peanuts

steps.text: Rinse poha in a colander under running water for 30s and drain well.
steps.tip: Do not soak or poha becomes mushy!

steps.text: Heat oil in a pan, fry peanuts until crunchy, then add mustard seeds and green chilli.
Sauté chopped onion (kanda) until translucent and soft.
Add turmeric, salt, drained poha, and toss gently on low heat.
Finish with fresh coriander and a squeeze of lemon juice.
steps.tip: Add a boiled egg on the side for 6g extra protein.

title: One-Pot Moong Dal Khichdi

steps.text: Rinse rice and moong dal together thoroughly.
In your kettle or pan, heat ghee with cumin seeds (jeera) and ginger.
Add rinsed dal-rice mix with 3 cups water, turmeric, and salt.
steps.tip: Add an extra half cup of water for comforting soul-food consistency.

steps.text: Cook until soft and creamy. Serve hot with a spoonful of dahi.
steps.tip: High satiety survival staple under ₹35.

title: Masala Oats with Boiled Eggs

steps.text: Boil 2 eggs in your kettle or small pot for 8 minutes.
In a pan, sauté onion, tomato, and green chilli with a pinch of garam masala.
Add rolled oats and 1.5 cups water. Cook for 3 minutes until thick.
Peel eggs, slice in half, place on top with cracked black pepper.
steps.tip: 26g protein power breakfast for under ₹40.

title: Paneer Tikka Quinoa Bowl

steps.text: Cook quinoa in salted water (1:2 ratio) for 12 minutes.
Cube paneer and toss with curd, red chilli powder, turmeric, and garam masala.
Sear marinated paneer on a hot pan for 2-3 mins per side until charred edges appear.
Assemble quinoa in bowl, top with paneer tikka, sliced onions, and chopped coriander.
steps.tip: Drizzle with mint chutney or lemon juice.

title: Truffle Mushroom Fettuccine

steps.text: Boil fettuccine pasta in heavily salted rolling water until al dente.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté sliced button mushrooms with minced garlic.
Add cooked fettuccine with 2 tbsp pasta water and emulsion toss.
Remove from heat, drizzle 1 tsp artisan truffle oil and grate cheese.
steps.tip: Never boil truffle oil directly — its delicate aroma is best preserved as a finishing drizzle.

title: Dragon Fruit & Blueberry Açaí Glow Bowl

steps.text: Blend frozen dragon fruit cubes, acai puree, and 1 ripe banana until velvety thick.
Pour thick smoothie base into chilled bowl.
Artfully arrange sliced dragon fruit, crunchy granola, and chia seeds.
steps.tip: Gourmet cafe antioxidant booster ready in 8 mins flat.

title: Sourdough Avocado Poached Eggs

steps.text: Toast sourdough slice in pan with a touch of butter until golden and crisp.
Mash ripe avocado with salt, pepper, and lime juice.
Poach or soft-fry 2 eggs in boiling water/pan for 3 minutes.
Spread avocado over toast, top with warm eggs and chilli flakes.
steps.tip: Slice open yolks for that iconic golden runny texture.

title: Norwegian Teriyaki Salmon Quinoa Bowl

steps.text: Simmer quinoa in 1 cup water with salt until tender and fluffy.
Sear seasoned salmon fillet skin-side down for 4 mins, flip for 3 mins.
Pour soy sauce, honey, and minced garlic over salmon in pan to glaze.
Assemble over quinoa, garnish with toasted seeds.
steps.tip: Omega-3 powerhouse with 42g pure protein.

title: Mumbai Street-Style Egg Bhurji & Pav

steps.text: Heat butter in pan, add cumin, chopped onions, and green chillies.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, and pav bhaji/garam masala.
Whisk 3 eggs with salt, pour into pan and scramble gently over medium heat.
Toast pav on the buttery pan and serve with coriander.
steps.tip: Street food comfort with 24g bioavailable protein.

title: Dorm Room Soya Keema Bhurji

steps.text: Soak soya chunks in boiling water for 8 mins, then squeeze dry and mince.
Heat oil, sauté cumin, onions, ginger, and garlic.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli, and garam masala.
Toss minced soya, cook for 4 minutes with a splash of water.
